name: style-linter
description: Blocks an em-dash or an emoji that Claude adds to a file, and notes passive voice in prose files.

emDash.title: Block em-dashes
emDash.description: Block a Write or an Edit that adds an em-dash to a file.

emoji.title: Block emoji
emoji.description: Block a Write or an Edit that adds an emoji to a file.

passive.title: Note passive voice
passive.description: Give Claude a note when new text in a prose file may use the passive voice.
